remaining_differences: Bominal reference has more Korean-first domain data and multi-screen settings/auth/onboarding depth than this single Oyatie shell currently shows.
Workflow canvas geometry is approximated in Leptos/CSS rather than exactly matching Bominal node layout and pan/zoom physics.
Interactions are visual/local only and intentionally not backend-wired.
Command Center still retains Oyatie render-envelope context controls above the workbench, so the top fold is not a pixel match to Bominal Corporate.

non_claims: No external messages, mail, or community posts are sent.
